violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: SLICED TOMATOES AT 53F IN TRUE 1 DOOR PREP TOP; SLICED TOMATOES AT 44-46 IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC TRANSFERRED TOMATOES TO FREEZER FOR RAPID COOLING TO 41F OR BELOW.

violations.title: Cooling from Ambient to 41F, No More than 4 Hours
violations.observation: The following food item prepared from ambient air temperature ingredients is not being adequately cooled to 41F or less within 4 hours: OBSERVED SEVERAL BAGS OF VARIOUS DELI MEATS IN WALK IN REFRIGERATOR SLICED BETWEEN 10:00-11:00 AM FOR MORE THAN 4 HOURS: HAM 47-51F, TURKEY 46- 51F, BEEF ROAST 58F.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be cooled within 4 hours to 41F or less if prepared from ingredients at ambient air temperature (i.e. reconstituted foods and canned tuna). EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC REMOVED FOODS TO BE DISCARDED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: MEATBALLS AT 119- 130F AND MARINARA SAUCE AT 128F IN STEAM TABLE NEAR CONVEYOR TOASTER.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO REHEAT FOODS TO 165F OR ABOVE DURING INSPECTION. POTBELLY SANDWICH SHOP (Inspection Date: 06/05/2025) Page 2 of 3

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: SANITIZER DISPENSER AT 3 COMPARTMENT SINK NOT DISPENSING SANITIZER AT TIME OF INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC INSTRUCTED EMPLOYEE TO MANUALLY ADJUST SANITIZE SOLUTION AND TEST CONCENTRATION WITH TEST STRIPS. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE DISPENSER HAS BE REPAIRED.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system: AT MOP SINK FAUCET CONNECTED TO CHEMICAL CLEANING SYSTEM.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EDUCATION PROVIDED. PIC PLACED ONLINE ORDER FOR APPROVED BACKFLOW PREVENTION DEVICE DURING INSPECTION. PLEASE EMAIL EHS ONCE INSTALLATION IS COMPLETED.
